summary: Assembles the HTTP API. Each domain (events, users, incidents, dashboard, risk engine, simulation, AI analyst, integration) lives in its own module with its own `APIRouter`, and this file mounts them all under the versioned `/api/v1` prefix as `api_router`, which `iip/app.py` adds to the FastAPI app.

notes.text: Module docstring: the HTTP API is split into one module per domain, all mounted under `/api/v1`.
`APIRouter` groups related endpoints so they can be defined in separate files and mounted together.
Imports the eight route modules of this package; each one defines a `router`.
The parent router. Every path gets the `/api/v1` prefix, so a future `v2` could live alongside it without breaking existing clients.
Mounts each module's router into the parent. This order is the order in which the endpoints appear in the generated OpenAPI docs and in the Integration page's endpoint catalog.
